correctness.rationale: Fix Y in M_n(F_q). Trace duality gives im(ad_Y)=C(Y)^⊥, so [X,Y]=Y² is soluble iff tr(Y²Z)=0 for every Z commuting with Y, and every soluble Y has precisely q^{dim C(Y)} partners. Over an algebraic closure, projection to each Jordan block J_ℓ(a)=aI+N detects trace ℓ a², and polynomial descriptions of a single-block commutant prove this condition sufficient on all blocks. Thus a=0 blocks are unrestricted, while each a≠0 Jordan size ℓ must satisfy p|ℓ; finite fields are perfect so each f-primary rational cyclic exponent ℓ for f≠t must be divisible by p. Summing centralizer-weighted similarity classes using the exact finite-field unit-centralizer formula and the q-binomial identity gives the submitted two Euler products coefficientwise; the extra nonnilpotent possibilities begin exactly in dimension p and add q|GL_p(q)| pairs at n=p. The n=2 formula is 2q⁴−q² for p≠2, q⁵+q⁴−q³ for p=2. A separate direct linear-system count over every Y gives N_{2,2}=40, N_{2,3}=153 and N_{3,2}=2192, validating fibers and the modular onset without treating finite checks as infinite proof.
residual_risks: Counts framed matrix pairs, not module-isomorphism classes or geometric irreducible components; q any finite p-power, n any nonnegative integer.
